about: Tool-surface vocabulary for the Gaia MCP server. NOTE: the three banned entries record VOCABULARY INTENT only. @gaia-research/mcp v0.1.0 is published and its README documents those tool names; renaming a live public interface is a breaking change and is NOT authorised by a lexicon entry. Roadmap V5-19 rules the final tool names open and schedules the rename for Arc III.

terms.definition: Prototype MCP tool name. Retired 2026-07-28: D4 fixes gaia-mcp's surface at two tools named `search_skills` and `summon`, and `summon`'s own entry already names `search_skills` as its partner. Nothing is published yet, so the prototype spelling never becomes a compatibility obligation.
terms.note: Banned before Program 4 writes its first tool definition — the ordering is available exactly once. The prototype server's own copy (`data/mcp.ts`, the Milim pet tooltips) is outside every lexicon scope and is not what this ban is aimed at; it is aimed at the tool definition Program 4 has not written yet.
